subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Loki the Betrayer
description: A fast breakdown of Loki the Betrayer for builders.

hook.text: Loki helped the gods many times. Then he murdered Baldr—the kindest god—and triggered the end of the world.

buildup.text: Loki was blood-brother to Odin. He lived among the gods, shape-shifted freely, and solved problems with wit.

discovery.text: He tricked blind Höðr into throwing mistletoe at Baldr, the only substance that could kill him.

twist.text: Loki's punishment was extreme: bound with his son's entrails, venom dripping on his face until Ragnarök.

climax.text: Loki shows the trickster's dark potential. Cleverness without loyalty becomes destruction.

punchline.text: He helped them. Then ended them.

quiz.question: Which god did Loki cause the death of?
